s.n: Mr Potato Head loaded potato bites
s.note: Andy's birthday, the new toy panic
s.how: Boil 1kg baby potatoes until tender, smash flat on an oiled tray and roast at 220C for 25 minutes. Top with 100g grated cheddar and 3 rashers crispy chopped bacon, return for 3 minutes, then add 150g sour cream and chives.
Blanch 200g peas and 200g edamame for 2 minutes and drain. Toss with chopped mint, lemon zest and juice, 2 tbsp olive oil and flaky salt. Spoon into little toy buckets or cups.

m.note: the claw machine at the pizza place
m.how: Stretch 2 balls pizza dough (500g total) into rounds. Spread with 200g crushed tomatoes, cover with 250g grated mozzarella, then arrange pepperoni rounds like planets and black olive slices like craters. Bake on the hottest tray at 250C for 10 minutes until blistered.

w.note: with a cowboy hat on top
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 250g sugar, add 4 eggs, then fold in 250g self-raising flour, 50g cocoa and 200ml milk. Bake in two tins at 175C for 30 minutes. Cover in 200g butter beaten with 350g icing sugar and 40g cocoa. Top with a fondant cowboy hat and candles.

d.note: the little green aliens in the claw machine
d.how: Mix 1L pineapple juice with 500ml lemonade, the juice of 2 limes and a few drops of green food colouring in a jug. Add ice and a handful of green grapes on sticks as aliens, and pour into cups.
